data.define: An idiom for very heavy rain.

misuse.text: Don't look for real animals when it's 'raining cats and dogs'.
misuse.why: It's an idiom for heavy rain.

publish.title: What does "raining cats and dogs" mean?
publish.value: Raining cats and dogs = Raining very hard. Example: "It's raining cats and dogs!" (casual English).
